AppearanceMenu.Name: Appearance

AppearanceMenu.Hint: Pick the UI font, card faces, card backs, and deal sounds.

AlwaysRevealHandHud.Hint: Keep your bottom hand HUD face-up without hovering over the cards.

DsnIntegration.Hint: Play 3D dice animations from Dice So Nice in Bone21 and Liar's Dice. Local visual only; results are authoritative on the server.

BeetleRaceSound.Hint: The GM decides for the whole table: turn it off and the race is silent for everyone. The GM’s speaker button on the race table flips the same setting.

BeetleRaceCleanTable.Hint: The GM decides for the whole table: put the table decorations away during the race so cups and card piles don’t cover the lanes. Only affects table skins that have decorations; also set in the start dialog.

Rates.Title: Prize Rates
Rates.Sub: Each spin picks a prize tier: big first, then medium, then small. The remainder is a miss.

Bank.Title: Table Chips
Bank.Note: Casino chips are tracked separately. NPCs and test bots have unlimited chips.

Setup.ParticipantsNote: Players use their assigned character, and chips stay on that character.
Setup.BlackjackParticipantsNote: Blackjack seats player characters and NPCs. NPCs bet and play automatically, while the DM still confirms each deal. If nobody joins, 5 test bots are added.
Setup.LiarsDiceParticipantsNote: Liar's Dice has no betting. Players, the GM, and NPCs can all join, and NPCs call or challenge automatically. If nobody joins, 5 test bots are added.
Setup.Bone21ParticipantsNote: Bones Twenty-One has no dealer. Players, the GM, and NPC seats can all join. If the GM joins, that seat acts last.
Setup.TexasHoldemParticipantsNote: Texas Hold'em seats 2 to 6 players. Regular players pay once at table start; the GM uses a separate session stack that is never settled.
Setup.SlotParticipantsNote: Only players and the GM can join this table. NPC seats are disabled, and the table keeps one active operator.

CardLuck.Label: Hand Luck
CardLuck.Help: Changes the odds of the cards you receive. It does not guarantee a win or loss.

Setup.TexasHoldemNote: Regular player buy-ins become table stacks and are returned when the table closes. The GM buy-in only moves inside this table.
Setup.TexasHoldemBuyInHint: Each player's stake; at least {amount} (10x the big blind)

Setup.SettlementNote: Choose how wins and losses are paid for this table.

Setup.CrazyEightsParticipantsNote: 2 to 8 players. Start with nobody ticked and the DM plays a test round against 3 bots; or tick players and drag NPCs in. The DM seat never pays or collects. From 6 players two decks are used.
Setup.CrazyEightsNote: Everyone antes into the pot for the winner; the leftover penalty pays the winner per point left in losing hands, 0 turns it off.
Setup.CrazyEightsPenaltyHint: Eights count 50, J/Q/K 10, aces 1, others face value. Capped at each balance; NPCs are exempt.
Setup.CrazyEightsDrawRuleOne: Draw one, then play or pass
Setup.CrazyEightsActionCardsTavern: Action cards: 8 changes suit, 2 draws, J skips, Q reverses
Setup.CrazyEightsSelfTest: (Nobody seated: the DM plays a test round against 3 bots)
Setup.BeetleRaceParticipantsNote: Everyone checked may bet, or just watch. Start with nobody checked and it's a DM test run: watch the beetles and try out cheats (the DM's bets don't touch any balance).
Setup.BeetleRaceNote: Pick a race card the DM prepared. It sets the runners, payout multipliers, race length and betting time.
Setup.BeetleRaceSound: Race sound (whole table; the GM can also mute it mid-race)
Setup.BeetleRaceCleanTable: Clear table: put the decorations away so the lanes stay in view

CrazyEights.Desc: A card game in which players match suit or rank to empty their hands, with eights used to name a suit.

Fields.AttributePathHint: Enter it manually or use the detector with a roll from a character sheet. The result applies only to this game.

OutcomeInfluence.Formula: For the card and dice games: effective win rate = base win rate + (attribute value / attribute points for each +5%) x 5, then clamped between the minimum and maximum.
OutcomeInfluence.BaccaratFormula: For Baccarat: both effective loss reduction % and effective win boost % start from the base values, then each full conversion step adds 5% to both.

Games.Title: Per-Game Setup

Detection.Name: Attribute Path Detector
Detection.Prompt: To detect the attribute path cleanly, set the target stat on a temporary character to a distinctive number, then roll that check from the character sheet.
Detection.PromptHint: A unique value like 999 makes it much easier to find the right path across different game systems.
Detection.Listening: Waiting for the next character-sheet roll...
Detection.NoRoll: No roll was detected within 60 seconds. Please try again.
Detection.NoActor: That roll could not be tied to an actor. Roll directly from the character sheet.
Detection.Found: Detected a usable path: {path} (modifier: {value}). Apply it to the current config?
Detection.FoundMultiple: Several possible paths matched modifier {value}. Pick the one that looks right.
Detection.NoMatch: No matching path was found for modifier {value}. You can enter one manually below.
Detection.ManualHint: If your system is unusual, it is fine to type the dot-path yourself.
Detection.Applied: The detected path was added to this game: {path}

dash.Name: Dash
dash.Desc: A sudden burst of speed with a trail of dust.

fly.Name: Take Flight
fly.Desc: Opens its wing cases and flies. The fastest move, and obviously fishy.

blink.Name: Blink
blink.Desc: Vanishes in a puff of smoke and pops out further ahead.

jet.Name: Gas Boost
jet.Desc: A green puff out the back and a lurch forward.

brake.Name: Slam Brakes
brake.Desc: Stops dead, leaving two skid marks.

spin.Name: Spin Out
spin.Desc: Slips and spins on the spot.

flip.Name: Belly Up
flip.Desc: Flips onto its back, legs kicking, and takes a while to right itself.

snack.Name: Snack Break
snack.Desc: Stops to nibble a crumb on the track.

nap.Name: Doze Off
nap.Desc: Falls asleep mid-race, Zzz and all.

moonwalk.Name: Moonwalk
moonwalk.Desc: Legs keep walking while the body slides backwards.

wander.Name: Wander
wander.Desc: Weaves from side to side and barely moves forward.

taunt.Name: Taunt
taunt.Desc: Turns around and waves its antennae at the others.

bow.Name: Bow
bow.Desc: Stops to bow to the crowd.

cheer.Name: Celebrate
cheer.Desc: Hops on the spot, celebrating early.

roll.Name: Roll Up
roll.Desc: Curls into a ball and rolls forward.

dig.Name: Burrow
dig.Desc: Digs in, pushes a mound of earth forward and pops out ahead.

sneeze.Name: Sneeze
sneeze.Desc: Holds it in, then ACHOO! and gets blown back a little.

mud.Name: Mud Trap
mud.Desc: Legs spin uselessly in the mud, splattering everywhere.

dungball.Name: Dung Ball
dungball.Desc: Stops to push a ball that keeps getting bigger. Very slow going.

dance.Name: Dance
dance.Desc: Wiggles in little circles with music notes popping out.

haste.Name: Haste
haste.Desc: Spell: a golden glow, and legs moving so fast they blur.

enlarge.Name: Enlarge
enlarge.Desc: Spell: grows to twice its size and takes huge strides.

freeze.Name: Freeze
freeze.Desc: Spell: frozen in a block of ice until it shatters.

zap.Name: Lightning Strike
zap.Desc: Spell: a bolt from above leaves it charred and smoking.

snail.Name: Snailify
snail.Desc: Spell: turned into a snail for a while, crawling slowly.

steady.Name: Steady
steady.Intro: {name} runs at an even pace and rarely gets into trouble.

greedy.Name: Greedy
greedy.Intro: {name} can't walk past food, race or no race.

hothead.Name: Hothead
hothead.Intro: {name} is famously hot-headed: surges when excited, and trips just as often.

lazy.Name: Lazy
lazy.Intro: {name} is always slow off the line and might nod off halfway.

clumsy.Name: Clumsy
clumsy.Intro: {name} has more enthusiasm than coordination; slips and tumbles are routine.

showoff.Name: Show-off
showoff.Intro: {name} lives for the crowd and will stop mid-race to strike a pose.

timid.Name: Timid
timid.Intro: {name} spooks easily: slams the brakes when nervous, even backs up.

sly.Name: Sly
sly.Intro: {name} stays quiet for most of the race and shows its hand only at the end.

copper.Name: Copper General
copper.Intro: Temper as red as his shell. Can't hold back once the gun fires, and often trips over his own feet.

jade.Name: Jade Widow
jade.Intro: Idles in the pack for most of the race and nobody remembers she's there. Until the last stretch.

indigo.Name: Indigo Ranger
indigo.Intro: Neither fast nor slow, never makes a mistake. His backers rarely get rich and rarely go broke.

golden.Name: Old Goldhorn
golden.Intro: The strongest old-timer on the track, provided he's awake. Always half a beat late off the line.

ash.Name: Ash Imp
ash.Intro: All enthusiasm, zero coordination. Flips over at least once a race. The crowd adores him.

amethyst.Name: Amethyst Princess
amethyst.Intro: Cares more about whether the crowd is watching than about the finish line.

crimson.Name: Rosy Butterball
crimson.Intro: Knows every breadcrumb on the track by name.

moss.Name: Moss Hermit
moss.Intro: Big body, small nerve. When anyone next to him surges, he wants to back off.

Bubble.fly1: Didn't know I could fly, did you?
Bubble.brake1: Wait, did I leave the stove on?
Bubble.rigged1: The house says I win today.
